links.comparator_used: Initial prompt design before iterative refinement (same models, GPT-3.5 and GPT-4)
links.outcome: Accuracy of numerical HEART subscore responses (mean error vs physician assessment) and rate of erroneous non-numerical responses
links.effect: For both models, the rate of erroneous, non-numerical subscore answers decreased from initial to final prompt. For GPT-4, mean error decreased from 0.16 to 0.10 points (95% CI 0.07-0.14) on a 0-2 point scale.
links.quote: Accuracy of numerical responses for HEART subscores (discrete 0-2 point scale) improved for GPT-4 from the initial to final prompt iteration, decreasing from a mean error of 0.16-0.10 (95% confidence interval: 0.07-0.14) points.
